transport.title: Trains to Vienna
transport.text: The S7 takes about 25 minutes to Wien Mitte and runs every 30 minutes; Railjet takes about 15 minutes to Wien Hauptbahnhof and runs every 30 minutes. The ÖBB ticket office is in the arrivals hall; ticket machines are also there, along the passages to the platforms and on the platforms. A short, weather-protected, step-free route leads from the arrivals hall to the platforms.

lounges.title: VIENNA Lounge
lounges.text: VIENNA Lounge is in Terminal 1 on Level 2, after security and before passport control; it is open daily from 04:30 to 22:00. With a valid boarding pass, entry on the day of departure is available from 3.5 hours before departure, with a maximum stay of 3 hours. The regular price is 59 EUR, children aged 4–14 pay 31 EUR, and children aged 0–3 enter free. Facilities include food, Wi-Fi, workspaces, a relaxation area, showers with towels and a family bathroom with a changing table.

sleep.title: Hotels near the airport
sleep.hint: NH and Moxy, a walk from terminal
sleep.text: NH Vienna Airport Conference Center and Moxy Vienna Airport are in AirportCity, near the terminal and within walking distance. NH has Wi-Fi and soundproof windows; Moxy offers snacks and drinks around the clock, free use of computers and the fitness centre, and free Wi-Fi.

kids.title: Play areas and strollers
kids.hint: Near gates F, C and D
kids.text: The free Entertainment Gate near F03 includes a two-storey play structure, a separate toddler area and table football; there are also children’s areas near C42 and D31–36. If your own stroller was checked in, the airport provides a free stroller for the route from security to the boarding gate; hand it to the gate agent when boarding. Changing tables are available in almost all accessible toilets, family toilets and large passenger toilets.
